name: RC-B10-0571/2025 – § 7/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘particularly those posed by its state-engineered instrumentalisation of migration’
part_context: Reiterates that it does not recognise Aliaksandr Lukashenka as the legitimate President of Belarus; stresses that any review of EU sanctions against Belarus or engagement with it must be strictly conditional upon Belarus effecting sustained, verifiable and irreversible systemic change, including the release of the more than 1 100 remaining political prisoners; calls for solidarity in addressing the threats posed by the Lukashenka regime, <del>particularly those posed by its state-engineered instrumentalisation of migration</del>; strongly condemns the Belarusian de facto authorities’ use of migration for political ends;
